definitions.is_holiday: 1 if the local date is a Norwegian public holiday (date-holidays 'NO', type public).
definitions.school_holiday: 1 in Oslo school holidays: ISO week 8, ISO week 40, Palm Sunday..Easter Monday, 21 Jun..17 Aug, 21 Dec..2 Jan.
definitions.payday_window: 1 on payday and the 2 days after. Payday = the 20th, moved back to the previous weekday that is not a public holiday.
definitions.days_to_christmas: Days from the local date to 24 Dec of the same year, clipped to -7..60 (25 Dec = -1, 31 Dec = -7).
definitions.ev_active: Sum over events active this hour (start <= t < end, within 3 km, not transit/cruise) of attendance * exp(-d/0.8 km) / max(3, duration h) / 100.
definitions.ev_pre: Sum over events (<= 12 h long, within 3 km) starting in (t, t+3h] of attendance * exp(-d/0.8 km) / 1000.
definitions.ev_post: Sum over events (<= 12 h long, within 3 km) that ended in (t-2h, t] of attendance * exp(-d/0.8 km) / 1000.
definitions.ev_near_count: Number of events active this hour within 1 km.
definitions.transit_disruption: 1 if a transit-category event (within 10 km) or a transit situation (severity not slight/noImpact) is active this hour.
definitions.rail_late5_share: Share of rail calls in the hour more than 5 min late (Entur). NaN when unknown.
definitions.rail_cancelled_share: Share of rail calls in the hour cancelled (Entur). NaN when unknown.
definitions.metro_late5_share: Share of metro calls in the hour more than 5 min late (Entur). NaN when unknown.
definitions.cruise_pax: Sum of passengers (default 2500) of cruise ships in port this hour / 1000.
definitions.crowd_nt_pre: Sum over events at a route venue (Ullevaal, Holmenkollen, Unity Arena, Bislett, Ekeberg; no distance cutoff) of attendance x route share / 1000, when the hour overlaps [start - travel - 2 h, start - travel). Shares and travel times are assumptions (ROUTE_VENUES).
definitions.crowd_nt_post: Same sum when the hour overlaps [end + travel, end + travel + 1.5 h). Events over 12 h count as daily sessions.
definitions.xmas_market: 1 when Jul i Vinterland (Spikersuppa, ~0.3 km) is open: 7 Nov..3 Jan, closed 24 Dec. 2026 season listed as 7 Nov 2026 - 3 Jan 2027; same window assumed every year.
